+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Op-level tests of the GLM-5.3-Flash MonoKernel on CDNA4, one process a TP rank.
+
+Each launch kind runs on random weights and is checked stage by stage against the
+ops vLLM itself runs for the same decode step, on the kernel's own inputs to each
+stage, at every width; then every width is captured in one graph and replayed,
+bit for bit against the first run. The checks live beside this file:
+
+- ``_ffn``: the FFN half (mHC seam, RMSNorm, router, top-8, shared expert, MXFP4
+  experts, MoE TP reduce), a stalled rank's expired waits and a late rank waited
+  out;
+- ``_kda``: the whole KDA layer (in-projections, short conv, gated delta rule,
+  gated norm, o_proj and its TP reduce), then the FFN half;
+- ``_dsa``: the whole sparse-attention layer (MLA and kpool index caches, the
+  indexer, top-2048 selection, split attention), bf16 or e4m3 KV cache;
+- ``_moe``: the FFN stages against vLLM's own ``Glm5NextMoE`` built from the
+  model config, through ``process_weights_after_loading``."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.utils import multi_process_parallel
+
+from . import _dsa, _ffn, _kda, _moe
+from ._ffn import _on_cdna4
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_cdna4(), reason="the Flash MonoKernel targets CDNA4"
+)
+
+
+def _ready(tp: int) -> None:
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < tp:
+        pytest.skip(f"needs {tp} GPUs")
+    pytest.importorskip("flydsl")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp, separate", [(2, True), (4, False), (4, True), (8, False)])
+def test_ffn_layer_matches_vllm_ops(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tp: int, separate: bool
+):
+    _ready(tp)
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, tp, 1, _ffn._worker(_ffn._check, separate))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("early_out", [False, True])
+def test_stalled_rank_reports_expiry(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, early_out: bool):
+    _ready(4)
+    multi_process_parallel(
+        monkeypatch, 4, 1, _ffn._worker(_ffn._check_fault, early_out)
+    )
+
+
+def test_late_rank_is_waited_for(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    _ready(4)
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, 4, 1, _ffn._worker(_ffn._check_slow_rank))
+
+
+def test_stalled_rank_in_sparse_attention_reports_expiry(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    _ready(4)
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, 4, 1, _ffn._worker(_dsa._check_fault))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("live", [0.0, 0.02, 0.5])
+def test_sparse_attention_selects_through_tied_scores(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, live: float
+):
+    _ready(4)
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, 4, 1, _ffn._worker(_dsa._check_ties, live))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tp, dim_first", [(2, False), (4, False), (4, True), (8, False)]
+)
+def test_kda_layer_matches_vllm_ops(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tp: int, dim_first: bool
+):
+    _ready(tp)
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, tp, 1, _ffn._worker(_kda._check, dim_first))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tp, fmt, kv_fp8",
+    [
+        (2, "mixed", False),
+        (4, "fp8", False),
+        (4, "bf16", False),
+        (8, "mixed", False),
+        (4, "mixed", True),
+        (8, "mixed", True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_dsa_layer_matches_vllm_ops(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Test kit for the GLM-5.3-Flash specialized decode on CPU: a supported fake
+config, a fake backbone and kernels, a fake forward context."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.models.glm5next.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import spec
+
+# kernel layers of the fake backbone: MoE layers 1..3 (layer 4 is the last)
+KERNEL_LAYERS = (1, 2, 3)
+
+
+def make_vllm_config(**overrides: Any) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    """The VllmConfig fields the config refusals read, all at a supported value
+    (only the platform is refused off ROCm / off gfx950)."""
+    parallel = dict(
+        pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+        data_parallel_size=1,
+        enable_expert_parallel=False,
+        enable_eplb=False,
+        decode_context_parallel_size=1,
+        prefill_context_parallel_size=1,
+        tensor_parallel_size=4,
+        use_sequence_parallel_moe=False,
+    )
+    parallel.update(overrides.pop("parallel", {}))
+    compilation = dict(
+        mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+        cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,
+        cudagraph_capture_sizes=[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32],
+    )
+    compilation.update(overrides.pop("compilation", {}))
+    cache = dict(cache_dtype="auto", mamba_ssm_cache_dtype="auto")
+    cache.update(overrides.pop("cache", {}))
+    hf = SimpleNamespace(model_type="glm5_next_text", **spec.GEOMETRY)
+    for key, value in overrides.pop("hf", {}).items():
+        setattr(hf, key, value)
+    cfg = SimpleNamespace(
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(**parallel),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_sleep_mode=False, enable_prompt_embeds=False, hf_text_config=hf
+        ),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(**cache),
+        offload_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            uva=SimpleNamespace(cpu_offload_gb=0),
+            prefetch=SimpleNamespace(offload_group_size=0),
+        ),
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(**compilation),
+        aux_output_config=SimpleNamespace(enable_return_routed_experts=False),
+        kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(monokernel=True),
+        speculative_config=None,
+        lora_config=None,
+        kv_transfer_config=None,
+        weight_transfer_config=None,
+        use_v2_model_runner=True,
+    )
+    for key, value in overrides.items():
+        setattr(cfg, key, value)
+    return cfg
+
+
+class FakeLayer(nn.Module):
+    """A vLLM-style layer: (positions, hidden, residual) -> (hidden, residual)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, idx: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.idx = idx
+        self.cache = torch.zeros(8, 4)
+        self.calls = 0
+        self.attn_name = f"layers.{idx}.attn"
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden, residual):
+        self.calls += 1
+        residual = hidden if residual is None else residual + hidden
+        return hidden + 1, residual
+
+
+class FakeBackbone(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: Any = None, n: int = 5) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config or make_vllm_config()
+        self.config = SimpleNamespace(
+            num_hidden_layers=n, mlp_layer_types=["dense"] + ["sparse"] * (n - 1)
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(FakeLayer(i) for i in range(n))
+        self.start_layer, self.end_layer = 0, n
+
+    def forward_layers(self, step, tokens: int):
+        hidden, residual = torch.zeros(tokens, 4), None
+        positions = torch.zeros(tokens, dtype=torch.long)
+        for idx, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            kernel = step.layer(idx) if step is not None else None
+            hidden, residual = (kernel or layer)(positions, hidden, residual)
+        return hidden, residual
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FakeKernel:
+    idx: int
+    width: int
+    words: torch.Tensor
+    launches: list = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    def launch(self, step, hidden, residual):
+        self.launches.append((self.idx, step.tokens, step.width))
+        residual = hidden if residual is None else residual + hidden
+        return hidden + 1, residual
+
+    def health(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.words
+
+
+def patch_layers(
+    monkeypatch,
+    log: list,
+    model_reasons: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    bind_reasons: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    eligible_reason: str | None = None,
+    rank: int = 0,
+) -> None:
+    """Replace the GLM layer builders with fakes, so the executor runs on CPU."""
+    from vllm.models.glm5next.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import decode, layers
+
+    words = torch.zeros(len(spec.STAGES), dtype=torch.int32)
+
+    def bind(ctx, caches):
+        log.append(("bind", tuple(sorted(caches))))
+        return list(bind_reasons)
+
+    def build(ctx, packed, layer, idx, width):
+        log.append(("build", idx, width))
+        return FakeKernel(idx, width, words)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(decode, "model_refusals", lambda b: list(model_reasons))
+
+    def pack(model, ctx):
+        log.append(("pack",))
+        return "packed"
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layers, "pack", pack)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layers, "bind", bind)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layers, "build", build)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layers, "eligible", lambda ctx, step: eligible_reason)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        layers, "metadata_names", lambda ls: [ls[i].attn_name for i in sorted(ls)]
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        layers, "CACHES", {"kv": ("cache", (torch.float32,), lambda layer: True)}
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr("vllm.distributed.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank", lambda: rank)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.distributed.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: 4
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.distributed.get_tp_group",
+        lambda: type("G", (), {"cpu_group": None})(),
+    )
+
+
+def decode_metadata(names: list[str], **fields: Any) -> dict[str, SimpleNamespace]:
+    base = dict(num_prefills=0, max_query_len=1)
+    base.update(fields)
+    return {n: SimpleNamespace(**base) for n in names}
+
+
+def forward_context(
+    metadata: Any, mode: CUDAGraphMode = CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(attn_metadata=metadata, cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CPU tests of the GLM-5.3-Flash specialized decode: config refusals, the per-step
+plan, cache binding and the fail-stop. The layer builders are the kit's fakes."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.models.glm5next.amd.specialized_decode.runtime import (
+    decode,
+    failstop,
+    spec,
+)
+from vllm.models.glm5next.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.decode import (
+    SpecializedDecode,
+)
+
+from . import kit
+
+STAGES = ("a", "b")
+PLATFORM = ("needs ROCm", "needs gfx950")
+
+
+def _reasons(cfg) -> list[str]:
+    return [r for r in spec.refusal_reasons(cfg) if r not in PLATFORM]
+
+
+def test_supported_config_passes():
+    assert _reasons(kit.make_vllm_config()) == []
+
+
+def test_every_reason_is_reported_at_once():
+    cfg = kit.make_vllm_config(
+        parallel=dict(
+            pipeline_parallel_size=2, enable_eplb=True, tensor_parallel_size=16
+        ),
+        compilation=dict(cudagraph_capture_sizes=[1, 2, 3, 4, 8]),
+        cache=dict(cache_dtype="fp8_e5m2", mamba_ssm_cache_dtype="bfloat16"),
+        hf=dict(hidden_size=2048, hc_mult=2),
+        lora_config=object(),
+        speculative_config=object(),
+        use_v2_model_runner=False,
+    )
+    reasons = _reasons(cfg)
+    for expected in (
+        "needs Model Runner V2",
+        "pipeline parallel",
+        "EPLB",
+        "LoRA",
+        "speculative decoding",
+        "capture sizes [3]",
+        "needs hidden_size 4096",
+        "needs hc_mult 4",
+        "tensor parallel size",
+        "fp8_e5m2 KV cache",
+        "bfloat16 KDA recurrent state",
+    ):
+        assert any(expected in r for r in reasons), (expected, reasons)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cache", ["auto", "bfloat16", "fp8", "fp8_e4m3", "mxfp4_mla"])
+def test_bf16_and_e4m3_kv_caches_pass(cache):
+    assert _reasons(kit.make_vllm_config(cache=dict(cache_dtype=cache))) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "compilation, ok",
+    [
+        (dict(cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE), False),
+        (dict(cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY), True),
+        (dict(cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE), True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_graph_modes(compilation, ok):
+    assert (_reasons(kit.make_vllm_config(compilation=compilation)) == []) is ok
+
+
+def test_switch_off_is_none_and_on_raises_with_every_reason():
+    off = kit.make_vllm_config()
+    off.kernel_config.monokernel = False
+    assert spec.specialized_decode_config(off) is None
+    cfg = kit.make_vllm_config(lora_config=object(), use_v2_model_runner=False)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="needs Model Runner V2.*LoRA"):
+        spec.specialized_decode_config(cfg)
+
+
+def _decode(monkeypatch, log=None, rank=0, **fakes):
+    log = [] if log is None else log
+    kit.patch_layers(monkeypatch, log, rank=rank, **fakes)
+    backbone = kit.FakeBackbone()
+    d = SpecializedDecode(backbone, spec.DecodeConfig(tp_size=4))
+    d.bind_caches()
+    return d, backbone, log
+
+
+def _plan(monkeypatch, d, fc, tokens):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(decode, "is_forward_context_available", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(decode, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc)
+    return d.plan(torch.zeros(tokens, dtype=torch.long), None)
+
+
+def _names(backbone):
+    return [backbone.layers[i].attn_name for i in kit.KERNEL_LAYERS]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens, width", [(1, 2), (2, 2), (4, 4), (8, 8)])
+def test_decode_step_runs_the_kernel_layers(monkeypatch, tokens, width):
+    d, backbone, log = _decode(monkeypatch)
+    fc = kit.forward_context(kit.decode_metadata(_names(backbone)))
+    step = _plan(monkeypatch, d, fc, tokens)
+    assert step is not None and step.step.width == width
+    hidden, _ = backbone.forward_layers(step, tokens)
+    assert backbone.layers[0].calls == backbone.layers[4].calls == 1
+    assert all(backbone.layers[i].calls == 0 for i in kit.KERNEL_LAYERS)
+    assert [k.launches for k in d.kernels[width].values()] == [
+        [(i, tokens, width)] for i in kit.KERNEL_LAYERS
+    ]
+    assert torch.equal(hidden, torch.full((tokens, 4), 5.0))
+    assert ("pack",) in log and sum(e[0] == "build" for e in log) == 9
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case",
+    [
+        dict(tokens=3),
+        dict(tokens=16),
+        dict(metadata=dict(num_prefills=1)),
+        dict(metadata=dict(max_query_len=2)),
+        dict(mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE),
+        dict(no_metadata=True),
+        dict(micro_batched=True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_other_steps_run_vllm_layers(monkeypatch, case):
+    d, backbone, _ = _decode(monkeypatch)
+    md = kit.decode_metadata(_names(backbone), **case.get("metadata", {}))
+    if case.get("no_metadata"):
+        md = None
+    if case.get("micro_batched"):
+        md = [md, md]
+    fc = kit.forward_context(md, case.get("mode", CUDAGraphMode.FULL))
+    tokens = case.get("tokens", 2)
+    assert _plan(monkeypatch, d, fc, tokens) is None
+    backbone.forward_layers(None, tokens)
+    assert all(layer.calls == 1 for layer in backbone.layers)
+
+
+def test_pipeline_inputs_run_vllm_layers(monkeypatch):
+    d, backbone, _ = _decode(monkeypatch)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(decode, "is_forward_context_available", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        decode,
+        "get_forward_context",
+        lambda: kit.forward_context(kit.decode_metadata(_names(backbone))),
+    )
+    assert d.plan(torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.long), object()) is None
+
+
+def test_layer_eligibility_can_decline(monkeypatch):
+    d, backbone, _ = _decode(monkeypatch, eligible_reason="long context")
+    fc = kit.forward_context(kit.decode_metadata(_names(backbone)))
+    assert _plan(monkeypatch, d, fc, 2) is None
+    assert failstop.counters["vllm_path:long context"] >= 1
+
+
+def test_decision_matches_on_every_rank(monkeypatch):
+    per_rank = []
+    for rank in range(4):
+        d, backbone, _ = _decode(monkeypatch, rank=rank)
+        names = _names(backbone)
+        steps = [
+            (kit.decode_metadata(names), 4),
+            (kit.decode_metadata(names, num_prefills=1), 4),
+            (kit.decode_metadata(names), 3),
+        ]
+        per_rank.append(
+            [
+                _plan(monkeypatch, d, kit.forward_context(md), n) is not None
+                for md, n in steps
+            ]
+        )
+    assert per_rank == [[True, False, False]] * 4
+
+
+def test_moved_caches_are_rebound_and_rechecked(monkeypatch):
+    d, backbone, log = _decode(monkeypatch)
+    fc = kit.forward_context(kit.decode_metadata(_names(backbone)))
+    for _ in range(2):
+        _plan(monkeypatch, d, fc, 2)
+    d.bind_caches()
+    assert sum(e[0] == "bind" for e in log) == 1

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The gfx950 native mxfp4_mla kernel: the V widening bit for bit against an
+exact dequant, decode rows against the bf16-unpack decode, and causal prefill
+rows against a torch emulation of its quantization and exact attention."""
+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla.decode import (
+    TILE_K,
+    _fold_v_scales,
+    _load_v_words,
+    _widen_v_128,
+)
+
+if current_platform.is_rocm() and torch.cuda.is_available():
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    _GFX950 = on_gfx950()
+else:
+    _GFX950 = False
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not _GFX950, reason="needs gfx950")
+
+LATENT, ROW, GROUP = 512, 272, 32
+_E2M1_VALUES = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0])
+
+
+def _dequantize(rows: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Packed ``[n, ROW]`` uint8 rows -> fp32 ``[n, LATENT]``."""
+    rows = rows.cpu()
+    data = rows[:, : LATENT // 2]
+    codes = torch.stack([data & 0x0F, data >> 4], dim=-1).reshape(len(rows), LATENT)
+    sign = torch.where(codes & 0x08 != 0, -1.0, 1.0)
+    values = _E2M1_VALUES[(codes & 0x07).long()] * sign
+    scales = torch.exp2(rows[:, LATENT // 2 :].float() - 127.0)
+    return values * scales.repeat_interleave(GROUP, dim=1)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _widen_kernel(cache_ptr, valid_ptr, v_ptr, vs_ptr, BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr):
+    tokens = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    valid = tl.load(valid_ptr + tokens) != 0
+    row_ptr = cache_ptr + tokens.to(tl.int64) * 272
+    k_scale = tl.load(
+        row_ptr[:, None] + 256 + tl.arange(0, 16)[None, :],
+        mask=valid[:, None],
+        other=127,
+    )
+    v_mult, block_max = _fold_v_scales(k_scale, valid, BLOCK_K)
+    word_ptr = row_ptr.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int32))
+    for chunk in tl.static_range(4):
+        words = _load_v_words(word_ptr, chunk, BLOCK_K)
+        v_fp8, v_scale = _widen_v_128(words, v_mult, block_max, chunk, BLOCK_K)
+        dims = chunk * 128 + tl.arange(0, 128)
+        tl.store(v_ptr + tokens[:, None] * 512 + dims[None, :], v_fp8.to(tl.float32))
+        tl.store(
+            vs_ptr
+            + dims[:, None] * (BLOCK_K // 32)
+            + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 32)[None, :],
+            v_scale,
+        )
+
+
+def test_widen_v_matches_dequant():
+    """Every e2m1 code, scales spread up to 2**8 below their 32-token block's
+    maximum (the exact range), and masked tokens: widened e4m3 V times its
+    block scale equals the dequantized row exactly. Masked tokens' V is
+    unchecked: the decode zeroes their P instead."""
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    block_k = TILE_K.value
+    cache = torch.randint(0, 256, (block_k, ROW), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    top = torch.randint(110, 140, (block_k // 32, 1, LATENT // GROUP))
+    drop = torch.randint(0, 9, (block_k // 32, 32, LATENT // GROUP))
+    cache[:, LATENT // 2 :] = (top - drop).reshape(block_k, LATENT // GROUP)
+    valid = torch.ones(block_k, dtype=torch.int32)
+    valid[[3, 40, 127]] = 0
+
+    v = torch.empty(block_k, LATENT, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    v_scale = torch.empty(LATENT, block_k // 32, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    _widen_kernel[(1,)](cache.cuda(), valid.cuda(), v, v_scale, BLOCK_K=block_k)
+
+    # v_scale[d, b] applies to tokens 32b..32b+31 of dim d.
+    block_scale = torch.exp2(v_scale.cpu().float() - 127.0).T.repeat_interleave(32, 0)
+    kept = valid.bool()
+    assert torch.equal((v.cpu() * block_scale)[kept], _dequantize(cache)[kept])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_splits", [1, 3, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads", [16, 8])
+def test_native_decode_matches_bf16_unpack(num_splits: int, heads: int):
+    """Ragged rows (empty, shorter than a tile, tile edges, several tiles) with
+    padded and out-of-range slots: the native decode stays within MXFP8 error
+    of the decode that unpacks the same rows to bf16."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla.store import store_mxfp4_mla
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import (
+        rocm_sparse_attn_decode_bf16,
+    )
+
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    num_kv = 1024
+    lens = torch.tensor([0, 1, 127, 128, 129, 600], dtype=torch.int32)
+    q = torch.randn(len(lens), heads, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    latent = torch.randn(num_kv, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    latent[:, ::97] *= 8.0
+    indptr = torch.zeros(len(lens) + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    indptr[1:] = torch.cumsum(lens, 0)
+    indices = torch.randint(0, num_kv, (int(indptr[-1]),), dtype=torch.int32)
+    indices[5], indices[300] = -1, num_kv + 7
+
+    packed = torch.zeros(num_kv, ROW, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    store_mxfp4_mla(latent.cuda(), torch.arange(num_kv).cuda(), packed)
+
+    def attend(native: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+        out = torch.zeros(len(lens), heads, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+        rocm_sparse_attn_decode_bf16(
+            q=q,
+            kv=packed.unsqueeze(1),
+            scale=LATENT**-0.5,
+            head_dim=LATENT,
+            nope_head_dim=LATENT,
+            rope_head_dim=0,
+            attn_sink=None,
+            output=out,
+            ragged_indices=indices.cuda(),
+            ragged_indptr=indptr.cuda(),
+            num_splits=num_splits,
+            kv_cache_dtype="mxfp4_mla",
+            native_mxfp4=native,
+        )
+        return out.float().cpu()
+
+    want, got = attend(False), attend(True)
+    assert torch.isfinite(got).all()
+    nonempty = lens > 0
+    err = (got - want)[nonempty].abs()
+    ref = want[nonempty].abs()
+    assert err.max() <= 0.05 * ref.max(), (err.max(), ref.max())
+    assert err.mean() <= 0.02 * ref.mean(), (err.mean(), ref.mean())
+
+
+def _mxfp8(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Round to MXFP8 as the kernel quantizes Q: e4m3 with one power-of-two
+    scale per 32 values, the block maximum mapped at or below 448."""
+    blocks = x.reshape(*x.shape[:-1], -1, GROUP)
+    amax = (
+        blocks.abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny)
+    )
+    scale = torch.exp2(torch.ceil(torch.log2(amax / 448.0)).clamp(-127, 127))
+    return ((blocks / scale).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float() * scale).reshape(x.shape)
+
+
+def _emulate_native(q: torch.Tensor, keys: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The native kernel's arithmetic for one row at one split, in fp32: MXFP8
+    Q, exact K and V, online softmax over TILE_K-token tiles with P rounded
+    to e4m3 as P * 256."""
+    q = _mxfp8(q.float())
+    log2_scale = LATENT**-0.5 * math.log2(math.e)
+    m = torch.full((q.shape[0],), -math.inf)
+    denom = torch.zeros(q.shape[0])
+    acc = torch.zeros(q.shape[0], LATENT)
+    for start in range(0, len(keys), TILE_K.value):
+        tile = keys[start : start + TILE_K.value]
+        s = q @ tile.T * log2_scale
+        m_new = torch.maximum(m, s.amax(-1))
+        alpha = torch.exp2(m - m_new)
+        p = torch.exp2(s - m_new[:, None])
+        denom = denom * alpha + p.sum(-1)
+        p8 = (p * 256.0).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float() / 256.0
+        acc = acc * alpha[:, None] + p8 @ tile
+        m = m_new
+    return acc / denom[:, None]
+
+
+def _native_prefill_case(topk: int):
+    """Causal prefill rows, as the backend sends them on gfx950: query t sees
+    min(t + 1, topk) of the first t + 1 slots. Returns the native kernel's
+    output at one split, its torch emulation and exact-dequant attention."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla.store import store_mxfp4_mla
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import (
+        rocm_sparse_attn_decode_bf16,
+    )
+
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    num_tokens, heads = 640, 16
+    lens = [min(t + 1, topk) for t in range(num_tokens)]
+    indices = torch.cat(
+        [torch.randperm(t + 1)[:n].sort().values for t, n in enumerate(lens)]
+    ).int()
+    indptr = torch.zeros(num_tokens + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    indptr[1:] = torch.cumsum(torch.tensor(lens), 0)
+    latent = torch.randn(num_tokens, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    latent[:, ::97] *= 8.0
+    packed = torch.zeros(num_tokens, ROW, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    store_mxfp4_mla(latent.cuda(), torch.arange(num_tokens).cuda(), packed)
+    q = torch.randn(num_tokens, heads, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    common = dict(
+        q=q,
+        kv=packed.unsqueeze(1),
+        scale=LATENT**-0.5,
+        head_dim=LATENT,
+        nope_head_dim=LATENT,
+        rope_head_dim=0,
+        attn_sink=None,
+        ragged_indices=indices.cuda(),
+        ragged_indptr=indptr.cuda(),
+        kv_cache_dtype="mxfp4_mla",
+    )
+    got = torch.zeros(num_tokens, heads, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    rocm_sparse_attn_decode_bf16(output=got, num_splits=1, native_mxfp4=True, **common)
+    got = got.float().cpu()
+
+    keys = _dequantize(packed)
+    q = q.cpu()
+    emulated = torch.empty_like(got)
+    exact = torch.empty_like(got)
+    for t in range(num_tokens):
+        row_keys = keys[indices[indptr[t] : indptr[t + 1]].long()]
+        emulated[t] = _emulate_native(q[t], row_keys)
+        weights = (q[t].double() @ row_keys.double().T * LATENT**-0.5).softmax(-1)
+        exact[t] = (weights @ row_keys.double()).float()
+    return got, emulated, exact
+
+
+# Measured kernel vs emulation at topk 128/300/2048: max 0.059 (bf16 output
+# rounding: |out| reaches 24, where half a bf16 ulp is 0.0625), mean 2.2e-4 to
+# 2.8e-4, against max 1.1-1.35 and mean 5.4e-3 to 6.8e-3 vs exact. Bounds are
+# the measured values plus about 25%.
+EMULATION_MAX_ABS_ERR = 0.075
+EMULATION_MEAN_ABS_ERR = 3.5e-4
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("topk", [128, 300])
+def test_native_on_prefill_rows(topk: int):
+    """Prefill rows now go through the native kernel, so Q is quantized to
+    MXFP8 there too. Tight: the kernel matches a torch emulation of exactly
+    that quantization, so any other error is a bug. Loose: the quantization
+    itself stays a small fraction of exact attention."""
+    got, emulated, exact = _native_prefill_case(topk)
+    assert torch.isfinite(got).all()
+    err = (got - emulated).abs()
+    assert err.max() <= EMULATION_MAX_ABS_ERR, err.max()
+    assert err.mean() <= EMULATION_MEAN_ABS_ERR, err.mean()
+    err, ref = (got - exact).abs(), exact.abs()
+    assert err.max() <= 0.07 * ref.max(), (err.max(), ref.max())
+    assert err.mean() <= 0.04 * ref.mean(), (err.mean(), ref.mean())

+read a packed cache."""

+import types

+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla import row_bytes

+# GLM-5.3's latent; the other widths check nothing is pinned to it.

+def _layer_spec(block_size: int = 64, latent: int = LATENT):
+    """The spec the MLA layer publishes for a GLM-5.3 main layer."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.mla_attention import MLAAttention
+
+    layer = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        kv_cache_dtype="mxfp4_mla",
+        head_size=latent,
+        sliding_window=None,
+        indexer=None,
+        topk_buffer_width=None,
+        non_causal_multi_token_decode=False,
+        attn_backend=types.SimpleNamespace(get_name=lambda: "ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE"),
+        _uses_flat_kv_cache=lambda: False,

+    config = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_config=types.SimpleNamespace(block_size=block_size),
+        model_config=types.SimpleNamespace(dtype=torch.bfloat16),

+
+
+def test_row_is_272_bytes_for_a_512_wide_latent():

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("latent", LATENT_WIDTHS)
+def test_dtype_selects_a_packed_uint8_row(latent: int):
+    from vllm.config.cache import CacheConfig

+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import (

+        "mxfp4_mla"

+    assert "mxfp4_mla" in ROCMAiterMLASparseBackend.supported_kv_cache_dtypes
+
+    spec = _layer_spec(latent=latent)
+    assert spec.dtype is torch.uint8
+    assert spec.page_size_bytes == 64 * (latent // 2 + latent // 32)
+
+
+def test_hybrid_block_size_matches_the_layer_page(monkeypatch):
+    """The platform sizes the hybrid block from the same row the layer uses.
+
+    GLM-5.3-Flash at TP=4 has a 1085440-byte mamba state; the glm5_next KV
+    grouping rejects the config if that exceeds the real MLA page.
+    """
+    import vllm.config.vllm as vllm_config_mod
+    from vllm.model_executor.models import ModelRegistry
+    from vllm.platforms.interface import Platform
+

+    model_cls = types.SimpleNamespace(

+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        vllm_config_mod, "set_current_vllm_config", lambda _: contextlib.nullcontext()
+    )
+    cache = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_dtype="mxfp4_mla",

+        mamba_block_size=None,
+        user_specified_mamba_block_size=False,
+        mamba_cache_mode="none",
+        mamba_page_size_padded=None,

+    config = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_config=cache,
+        parallel_config=None,
+        model_config=types.SimpleNamespace(
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            use_mla=True,
+            architecture="GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM",
+            get_num_kv_heads=lambda _: 1,
+            get_head_size=lambda: LATENT,

+    backend = types.SimpleNamespace(get_supported_kernel_block_sizes=lambda: [64])

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("latent", LATENT_WIDTHS)
+def test_decode_and_prefill_take_the_triton_route(latent: int):

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype", ["auto", "fp8"])
+def test_other_dtypes_forward_skip_scale_to_the_base_update(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The mxfp4_mla read path: the row unpack on its own, with the gfx950
+hardware converter and with the software path used elsewhere, and the
+attention kernels that read a packed cache through it."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla.read import _load_mxfp4_rows
+
+if current_platform.is_rocm() and torch.cuda.is_available():
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    _CDNA_VERSION = get_cdna_version()
+else:
+    _CDNA_VERSION = 0
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    _CDNA_VERSION not in (3, 4), reason="mxfp4_mla needs CDNA 3 or 4 (gfx942 or gfx950)"
+)
+
+LATENT, ROW, GROUP, BLOCK_K = 512, 272, 32, 16
+_E2M1_VALUES = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0])
+
+
+def _dequantize(rows: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Packed ``[n, ROW]`` uint8 rows -> fp32 ``[n, LATENT]``."""
+    rows = rows.cpu()
+    data = rows[:, : LATENT // 2]
+    codes = torch.stack([data & 0x0F, data >> 4], dim=-1).reshape(len(rows), LATENT)
+    sign = torch.where(codes & 0x08 != 0, -1.0, 1.0)
+    values = _E2M1_VALUES[(codes & 0x07).long()] * sign
+    scales = torch.exp2(rows[:, LATENT // 2 :].float() - 127.0)
+    return values * scales.repeat_interleave(GROUP, dim=1)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _gather_kernel(
+    cache_ptr,
+    slots_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    num_slots,
+    row_pitch,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    LATENT: tl.constexpr,
+    HW_UNPACK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    offsets = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    slots = tl.load(slots_ptr + offsets).to(tl.int64)
+    valid = (slots >= 0) & (slots < num_slots)
+    values = _load_mxfp4_rows(
+        cache_ptr,
+        tl.where(valid, slots, 0),
+        valid,
+        row_pitch,
+        BLOCK_K,
+        LATENT,
+        HW_UNPACK,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + offsets[:, None] * LATENT + tl.arange(0, LATENT)[None, :], values
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "hw_unpack",
+    [
+        False,
+        pytest.param(
+            True,
+            marks=pytest.mark.skipif(_CDNA_VERSION != 4, reason="needs gfx950"),
+        ),
+    ],
+    ids=["software", "gfx950"],
+)
+def test_load_rows_matches_reference(hw_unpack: bool):
+    """Every code and a wide spread of scales, gathered from scattered slots;
+    padded and out-of-range slots read as zero."""
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    num_rows = 64
+    cache = torch.randint(0, 256, (num_rows, ROW), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    cache[:, LATENT // 2 :] = torch.randint(100, 151, (num_rows, LATENT // GROUP))
+    slots = torch.randperm(num_rows)[: 2 * BLOCK_K]
+    slots[3], slots[20] = -1, num_rows + 5
+
+    out = torch.empty(len(slots), LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    _gather_kernel[(len(slots) // BLOCK_K,)](
+        cache.cuda(),
+        slots.cuda(),
+        out,
+        num_rows,
+        ROW,
+        BLOCK_K=BLOCK_K,
+        LATENT=LATENT,
+        HW_UNPACK=hw_unpack,
+    )
+
+    valid = (slots >= 0) & (slots < num_rows)
+    want = torch.zeros(len(slots), LATENT)
+    want[valid] = _dequantize(cache[slots[valid]])
+    assert torch.equal(out.float().cpu(), want)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_splits", [1, 4], ids=["ragged", "split_k"])
+def test_attention_matches_dequantized_cache(num_splits: int):
+    """Attention over the packed cache equals attention over the same values
+    stored as bf16, through the ragged kernel and the split-K decode kernel."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla.store import store_mxfp4_mla
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import (
+        rocm_sparse_attn_decode_bf16,
+        rocm_sparse_attn_prefill,
+    )
+
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    num_queries, heads, num_kv, per_query = 4, 16, 128, 64
+    q = torch.randn(num_queries, heads, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+    latent = torch.randn(num_kv, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    latent[:, ::97] *= 8.0
+    indices = torch.randint(0, num_kv, (num_queries * per_query,), dtype=torch.int32)
+    indptr = torch.arange(num_queries + 1, dtype=torch.int32) * per_query
+
+    packed = torch.zeros(num_kv, ROW, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    store_mxfp4_mla(latent.cuda(), torch.arange(num_kv).cuda(), packed)
+    dequantized = _dequantize(packed).to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+
+    def attend(kv: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        out = torch.empty(num_queries, heads, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+        common = dict(
+            q=q,
+            kv=kv.unsqueeze(1),
+            scale=LATENT**-0.5,
+            head_dim=LATENT,
+            nope_head_dim=LATENT,
+            rope_head_dim=0,
+            attn_sink=None,
+            output=out,
+            ragged_indices=indices.cuda(),
+            ragged_indptr=indptr.cuda(),
+            kv_cache_dtype="mxfp4_mla" if kv.dtype == torch.uint8 else "auto",
+        )
+        if num_splits == 1:
+            rocm_sparse_attn_prefill(indices=None, topk_length=None, **common)
+        else:
+            rocm_sparse_attn_decode_bf16(num_splits=num_splits, **common)
+        return out.cpu()
+
+    assert torch.equal(attend(packed), attend(dequantized))

+"""The mxfp4_mla store kernel must write exactly what AITER's MXFP4 quantizer
+produces, into the right rows of the paged cache."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (current_platform.is_rocm() and torch.cuda.is_available()),
+    reason="mxfp4_mla is ROCm-only",
+)
+
+LATENT, ROW = 512, 272
+UNTOUCHED = 0xCD
+
+
+def test_store_matches_aiter():
+    """Bit-exact against ``per_1x32_f4_quant`` on the layout the backend hands
+    the kernel: blocks strided past ``block_size`` rows by other layers' pages,
+    padded slots, and a latent that is a slice of a wider buffer."""
+    pytest.importorskip("aiter")
+    quant = pytest.importorskip("aiter.ops.quant")
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.mxfp4_mla.store import store_mxfp4_mla
+
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    num_blocks, block_size, gap = 8, 8, 5
+    backing = torch.full(
+        (num_blocks, block_size + gap, ROW), UNTOUCHED, dtype=torch.uint8
+    ).cuda()
+    cache = backing[:, :block_size]
+
+    # 64 tokens, two of them padding; two slots are never written.
+    num_slots = num_blocks * block_size
+    wide = torch.randn(num_slots, 2 * LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    wide[:, ::97] *= 8.0
+    latent = wide.cuda()[:, :LATENT]
+    written = torch.randperm(num_slots)[: num_slots - 2]
+    slots = torch.cat([written, torch.tensor([-1, -1])])
+
+    store_mxfp4_mla(latent, slots.cuda(), cache)
+
+    packed, scales = quant.per_1x32_f4_quant(latent.float().cpu(), pack_dim=-1)
+    want = torch.cat(
+        [
+            packed.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(len(slots), -1),
+            scales.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(len(slots), -1),
+        ],
+        dim=1,
+    )
+    got = backing.cpu()
+    for token, slot in enumerate(written.tolist()):
+        block, offset = divmod(slot, block_size)
+        assert torch.equal(got[block, offset], want[token]), f"slot {slot}"
+    for slot in set(range(num_slots)) - set(written.tolist()):
+        block, offset = divmod(slot, block_size)
+        assert (got[block, offset] == UNTOUCHED).all(), f"slot {slot} was written"
+    assert (got[:, block_size:] == UNTOUCHED).all(), "a write landed between blocks"

+# GLM-5.3-Flash specialized decode
+
+`--monokernel` on MI355X/gfx950 runs each MoE decoder layer 3-43 of a decode
+step as one persistent FlyDSL launch (256 CTAs, one per CU), inside vLLM's
+layer loop. There are two launch kinds (`mono/ffn/kernel.py`):
+
+- **KDA layers** (30): attention-side mHC seam, in-projections, short conv,
+  KDA gates and recurrence, gated norm, o_proj and its TP reduce;
+- **sparse-attention layers** (11): attention-side mHC seam, fused q_a / kv_a,
+  KV and kpool index-cache writes, the indexer query (FWHT-128 + FP8), pool
+  scoring and top-2048 selection, split attention, o_proj and its TP reduce;
+
+each followed by the FFN half: mHC seam, RMSNorm, router, top-8, shared
+expert, MXFP4 experts and the MoE TP reduce. Layers 0-2 and 44 (whose mHC
+post contracts the streams) run vLLM's code.
+
+## Supported
+
+- Checkpoint: `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4` (exact geometry checked), routed
+  experts on the `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` MoE backend; attention projections FP8
+  block-128 or bf16.
+- TP 2, 4 or 8 on dedicated, unpartitioned GPUs; Model Runner V2.
+- Pure decode of 1, 2, 4 or 8 rows (widths 2/4/8; 2/4 at TP2), eager or
+  replayed from a FULL CUDA graph. Prefill, mixed and larger steps and
+  PIECEWISE replays run vLLM's layers.
+- KV cache bf16, e4m3 (`--kv-cache-dtype fp8`) or `mxfp4_mla`; KDA recurrent
+  state fp32.
+
+## Layout
+
+`runtime/` owns refusals, planning, cache binding and health:
+
+- `spec.py`: `DecodeConfig`, config refusals, `specialized_decode_config()`;
+- `guards.py`: refusals of the loaded model;
+- `weights.py`: views of vLLM's loaded weights and their checks (no copy);
+- `layers.py`: packing, cache binding, eligibility and the launch per layer;
+- `decode.py`: `SpecializedDecode` (`plan()`, `bind_caches()`, `after_step()`)
+  and `Step.layer()`;
+- `routing.py`: the rank-uniform per-step decision;
+- `failstop.py`: the health check of the kernels' error words.
+
+`mono/` owns the kernels and their host launchers. `../model_state.py` builds
+the decode after load and binds it to every KV cache vLLM allocates.
+
+## Refusals
+
+Unsupported deployments are refused with every reason at once: the config
+before load (platform, MRv2, PP, DP, EP, EPLB, DCP, PCP, LoRA, KV connectors,
+routed-expert capture, speculative decoding, sleep mode, CPU weight offload,
+weight updates, prompt embeds, graph modes and capture sizes, geometry, TP
+size, sequence-parallel MoE, cache dtypes), the model after load (MoE backend,
+layer kinds, FlyDSL, compute units) and the caches at every bind (dtype, shape,
+strides).
+
+## Fail-stop
+
+Every cross-CTA and cross-rank wait is bounded. An expired wait sets its
+stage's sticky error word. After each step (`compute_logits`) the health check
+reads the previous step's words without blocking the stream: the output rank
+raises with the stage names and exits after a grace period, the other ranks
+exit their workers. `VLLM_MONO_UNSAFE_WARN=1` logs and clears instead (debug
+only); `VLLM_MONO_FAULT_INJECT=rank=R,step=N,us=D` stalls a rank for the fault
+test.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Device-visible layout every MonoKernel shares with the host runtime.
+
+Error words: one int32 per wait stage per kernel runtime, sticky. An expired wait
+stores 1 into its stage's word. With TP peers it also stores 1 into its own rank's
+flag in the output rank's flag array, then a release fence, then any further data.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+MONO_ABI_VERSION = 1
+ERROR_WORD_BYTES = 4
+FLAG_BYTES = 4
+FAULT_INJECT_ENV = "VLLM_MONO_FAULT_INJECT"
+UNSAFE_WARN_ENV = "VLLM_MONO_UNSAFE_WARN"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FaultSpec:
+    """Test-only: stall ``rank`` for ``us`` microseconds at kernel step ``step``."""
+
+    rank: int
+    step: int
+    us: int
+
+
+def fault_spec() -> FaultSpec | None:
+    """The build-time fault hook, from ``VLLM_MONO_FAULT_INJECT="rank=R,step=N,us=D"``.
+    Unset: kernels generate no fault code."""
+    raw = os.environ.get(FAULT_INJECT_ENV)
+    if not raw:
+        return None
+    fields = dict(kv.split("=", 1) for kv in raw.split(","))
+    try:
+        return FaultSpec(int(fields["rank"]), int(fields["step"]), int(fields["us"]))
+    except (KeyError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f'{FAULT_INJECT_ENV} must look like "rank=R,step=N,us=D", got {raw!r}'
+        ) from error
+
+
+def unsafe_warn() -> bool:
+    return os.environ.get(UNSAFE_WARN_ENV) == "1"

+        """``attn_part``: this rank's unreduced attention output [S, HIDDEN];
+        ``residual`` [S, HC, HIDDEN], ``post`` [S, HC, 1], ``comb`` [S, HC, HC]: the
+        attention pre's state. A KDA op takes the previous layer's output, its
+        state, and ``state_idx`` int32 [S] (not positive: padding) instead. A
+        sparse-attention op takes the previous layer's output, its caches, the
+        step's ``rows`` int32 [S, ROW_WORDS] and the int32 block tables of the MLA
+        cache and of the index cache (default: the MLA one).
+        Returns the layer's (x, residual, post, comb)."""
+        rt, w, S = self.rt, self.w, self.rt.width
+        _check("attn_part", attn_part, (S, HIDDEN), torch.bfloat16)
+        _check("residual", residual, (S, HC_MULT, HIDDEN), torch.bfloat16)
+        _check("post", post, (S, HC_MULT, 1), torch.float32)
+        _check("comb", comb, (S, HC_MULT, HC_MULT), torch.float32)
+        x_out, res_out, post_out, comb_out = rt.outs[self.layer % 2]
+        p = lambda t: t.data_ptr()  # noqa: E731
+        kda_args = [0] * 17
+        dsa_args = [0, 0]
+        if self.dsa is not None:
+            if caches is None or rows is None or block_table is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "a sparse-attention launch needs caches, rows and a block table"
+                )
+            _check("rows", rows, (S, ROW_WORDS), torch.int32)
+            if (
+                caches.kv_fp8 != rt.kv_fp8
+                or caches.kv_mxfp4 != rt.kv_mxfp4
+                or (caches.kv_fp8 and caches.k_scale is None)
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{caches.kv_cache_dtype} MLA cache on a kv_fp8={rt.kv_fp8} "
+                    f"kv_mxfp4={rt.kv_mxfp4} runtime (an fp8 cache needs its k_scale)"
+                )
+            if idx_block_table is None:
+                idx_block_table = block_table
+            for bt in (block_table, idx_block_table):
+                if bt.dtype != torch.int32 or bt.stride(1) != 1:
+                    raise ValueError("needs int32 block tables with contiguous rows")
+            d = self.dsa
+            kda_args[:4] = [p(d.hc_fn), p(d.hc_scale), p(d.hc_base), p(d.g_norm)]
+            tab = self._dsa_table(caches, block_table, idx_block_table)
+            dsa_args = [p(tab), p(rows)]
+        if self.kda is not None:
+            if state is None or state_idx is None:
+                raise ValueError("a KDA launch needs its state and state indices")
+            _check("state_idx", state_idx, (S,), torch.int32)
+            k = self.kda
+            kda_args = [
+                *map(p, (k.hc_fn, k.hc_scale, k.hc_base, k.g_norm, k.w_in, k.w_fb)),
+                *map(p, (k.w_gb, k.conv_w, k.a_log, k.dt_bias, k.w_on, k.w_o)),
+                p(state.conv_state),
+                p(state.rec_state),
+                p(state_idx),
+                state.conv_stride,
+                state.rec_stride,
+            ]
+        rt.launch(
+            p(attn_part),
+            p(residual),
+            p(post),
+            p(comb),
+            p(w.hc_fn),
+            p(w.hc_scale),
+            p(w.hc_base),
+            p(w.g_norm),
+            p(res_out),
+            p(post_out),
+            p(comb_out),
+            p(x_out),
+            p(w.w_r),
+            p(w.bias),
+            p(w.w_ug),
+            p(w.s_ug),
+            p(w.w_dn),
+            p(w.s_dn),
+            p(w.w_sh_ug),
+            p(w.s_sh_ug),
+            p(w.w_sh_dn),
+            p(w.s_sh_dn),
+            *kda_args,
+            *dsa_args,
+            p(rt.scratch),
+            rt.peer.storage.data_ptr(),
+            p(rt.peer.addresses),
+            p(rt.step),
+            rt.rank,
+            self.layer,
+            stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        )
+        return x_out, res_out, post_out, comb_out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from the GLM-5 MonoKernel of ROCm/FlyDSL#1204 (@coderfeli),
+# kernels/monokernel/ops.py, and ROCm/ATOM#2435 (@XiaobingSuper),
+# atom/model_ops/monokernel/ops.py (Apache-2.0 License),
+# Copyright (c) 2025 FlyDSL Project Contributors.
+
+"""Common AMD expression primitives for fused model-layer kernels."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.dpp_utils import update_dpp_i32
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T, as_ir_value
+
+_UMAX_DPP_ASM = "\n".join(
+    [
+        "s_nop 1\nv_max_u32_dpp $0, $0, $0 " + control
+        for control in (
+            "row_shr:1 bound_ctrl:0",
+            "row_shr:2 bound_ctrl:0",
+            "row_shr:4 bound_ctrl:0",
+            "row_shr:8 bound_ctrl:0",
+            "row_bcast:15 row_mask:0xa",
+            "row_bcast:31 row_mask:0xc",
+        )
+    ]
+)
+
+
+def rsrc(addr):
+    return bo.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(addr)
+
+
+def uniform(value):
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(value).ir_value()))
+
+
+def uniform_f32(value):
+    return uniform(fx.Float32(value).bitcast(fx.Int32)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def spin_pause() -> None:
+    """Keep tagged-mailbox polling loads inside the retry loop."""
+    llvm.InlineAsmOp(None, [], "s_nop 0", "", has_side_effects=True)
+
+
+def read_lane_i32(value, lane):
+    """Read one i32 from ``lane`` while keeping IR conversion local."""
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(value), fx.Int32(lane)))
+
+
+def write_lane_i32(value, lane, vector):
+    """Write one i32 into ``lane`` of a wave-distributed value."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(
+            T.i32,
+            "llvm.amdgcn.writelane.i32",
+            [as_ir_value(fx.Int32(item)) for item in (value, lane, vector)],
+            [],
+            [],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def bpermute_i32(byte_offset, value):
+    """Read an i32 VGPR value from the lane selected by a byte offset."""
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.ds_bpermute(T.i32, fx.Int32(byte_offset), fx.Int32(value)))
+
+
+# ticks of ``mem_realtime`` a microsecond (its constant 100 MHz clock)
+REALTIME_PER_US = 100
+
+
+def mem_realtime():
+    """Read the device-wide 64-bit realtime counter."""
+    return fx.Int64(llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], []))
+
+
+def _hardware_f32(name, value):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(T.f32, name, [fx.Float32(value).ir_value()], [], [])
+    )
+
+
+def rsq(value):
+    return _hardware_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rsq.f32", value)
+
+
+def rcp(value):
+    return _hardware_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rcp.f32", value)
+
+
+def exp(value):
+    return _hardware_f32("llvm.amdgcn.exp2.f32", fx.Float32(value) * 1.4426950408889634)
+
+
+def xshfl(value, offset):
+    """Return the value from ``lane ^ offset`` using VALU/DPP operations."""
+    if offset >= 16:
+        return value.shuffle_xor(offset, 64)
+    is_float = isinstance(value, fx.Float32)
+    source = value.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_float else fx.Int32(value)
+    if offset == 8:
+        result = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(source, source, 0x118, 0xF, 0xC, False))
+        result = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(result, source, 0x108, 0xF, 0x3, False))
+    elif offset == 4:
+        result = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(source, source, 0x114, 0xF, 0xA, False))
+        result = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(result, source, 0x104, 0xF, 0x5, False))
+    elif offset == 2:
+        result = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(source, source, 0x4E, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    else:
+        result = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(source, source, 0xB1, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    return result.bitcast(fx.Float32) if is_float else result
+
+
+def wave_umax_dpp(value):
+    """Return a wave maximum through the tuned GLM/TileRT DPP schedule."""
+    result = llvm.InlineAsmOp(
+        T.i32, [as_ir_value(fx.Int32(value))], _UMAX_DPP_ASM, "=v,0"
+    ).result
+    return read_lane_i32(result, 63)
+
+
+def xred(value, offset, op):
+    """Combine a value with ``lane ^ offset`` using a symmetric operation."""
+    if offset < 16:
+        return op(value, xshfl(value, offset))
+    is_float = isinstance(value, fx.Float32)
+    source = as_ir_value(value.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_float else fx.Int32(value))
+    swap = rocdl.permlane32_swap if offset == 32 else rocdl.permlane16_swap
+    pair = swap(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]), source, source, False, False
+    )
+    lhs, rhs = (fx.Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, pair, [index])) for index in range(2))
+    if is_float:
+        return op(lhs.bitcast(fx.Float32), rhs.bitcast(fx.Float32))
+    return op(type(value)(lhs), type(value)(rhs))
+
+
+def fp8_roundtrip(lhs, rhs):
+    """Round an f32 pair through E4M3FN and return the f32 pair."""
+    word = rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, lhs, rhs, fx.Int32(0), False)
+    pair_type = fx.Vector.make_type(2, fx.Float32)
+    pair = fx.Vector(rocdl.cvt_pk_f32_fp8(res=pair_type, src=word, word_sel=False))
+    return pair[0], pair[1]
+
+
+def div_rn(value, divisor, reciprocal):
+    """IEEE-rounded quotient from one exact reciprocal using Markstein refinement."""
+    quotient = value * reciprocal
+    residual = fmath.fma(-quotient, divisor, value)
+    return fx.Float32(fmath.fma(fx.Float32(residual), reciprocal, quotient))
+
+
+def fp8_pack4(a, b, c, d):
+    """Pack four in-range FP32 values as E4M3 bytes."""
+    lo = fx.Int32(rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, a, b, fx.Int32(0), False))
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, c, d, lo, True))
+
+
+def f8_word(k):
+    """Map an FP8 activation index to the packed LDS word order."""
+    return (k // 64) * 16 + ((k % 32) // 8) * 4 + ((k % 64) // 32) * 2 + (k % 8) // 4
+
+
+def fp8_to_bf16x8(word0, word1, scale=None):
+    """Convert two dwords of eight FP8 values to a BF16 vector, times ``scale``
+    (an f32 value; 1 when omitted)."""
+    one = as_ir_value(fx.Float32(1.0) if scale is None else scale)
+    parts = []
+    for word in (word0, word1):
+        for half in range_constexpr(2):
+            pair = fx.Vector(
+                rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp8(
+                    T.vec(2, T.bf16), as_ir_value(word), one, bool(half)
+                )
+            )
+            parts += [pair[0], pair[1]]
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(parts, fx.BFloat16)
+
+
+def mxfp4_to_bf16x8(word, scale):
+    """Convert one packed dword of eight scaled E2M1 values to BF16."""
+    parts = []
+    for select in range_constexpr(4):
+        pair = fx.Vector(
+            rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp4(
+                T.vec(2, T.bf16),
+                as_ir_value(word),
+                as_ir_value(scale),
+                select,
+            )
+        )
+        parts += [pair[0], pair[1]]
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(parts, fx.BFloat16)

+# Adapted from the GLM-5 MonoKernel of ROCm/FlyDSL#1204 (@coderfeli),

+
+"""Host-side weight packing for the FFN launch."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+
+def pack_bf16(w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack BF16 ``[N, K]`` for the kernel's 16-row, 64-K MFMA tiles."""
+    if w.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"BF16 packing expects a matrix, got shape {tuple(w.shape)}")
+    rows, k = w.shape
+    if rows % 16 or k % 64:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"BF16 matrix dimensions must be divisible by (16, 64), got {(rows, k)}"
+        )
+    w16 = w.view(torch.int16).reshape(rows // 16, 16, k // 64, 2, 4, 8)
+    return w16.permute(0, 2, 3, 4, 1, 5).contiguous().view(-1)
+
+
+def pack_shared_expert(
+    gate_up: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_up_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    down: torch.Tensor,
+    down_scale: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A row-major MXFP4 SwiGLU MLP as one expert of the AITER-shuffled MoE layout.
+
+    ``gate_up`` ``[2 * I, K // 2]`` (gate rows, then up rows), ``down``
+    ``[N, I // 2]``, each scale one E8M0 per 32 inputs, ``[rows, inputs // 32]``.
+    Returns ``(w_ug, s_ug, w_dn, s_dn)`` as bytes."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_scale, shuffle_weight
+
+    def weight(t):
+        fp4 = t.view(torch.uint8).contiguous().view(torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2)
+        return shuffle_weight(fp4, layout=(16, 16)).view(torch.uint8)
+
+    def scale(t):
+        return shuffle_scale(t.view(torch.uint8).contiguous()).view(torch.uint8)
+
+    return weight(gate_up), scale(gate_up_scale), weight(down), scale(down_scale)

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Symmetric peer buffers: one allocation per TP rank, mapped on every rank."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+_IPC_HANDLE_BYTES = 64
+_LAZY_ENABLE_PEER_ACCESS = 0x1
+_RANGE_START_ADDR = 11
+
+
+class _IpcHandle(ctypes.Structure):
+    _fields_ = [("reserved", ctypes.c_byte * _IPC_HANDLE_BYTES)]
+
+
+_hip = None
+
+
+def _lib():
+    global _hip
+    if _hip is not None:
+        return _hip
+    names = [f"libamdhip64.so{v}" for v in ("", ".7", ".6")]
+    root = os.environ.get("ROCM_PATH")
+    paths = [os.path.join(root, "lib", n) for n in names] if root else []
+    for name in paths + names:
+        try:
+            lib = ctypes.CDLL(name)
+            break
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+    else:
+        raise RuntimeError("MonoKernel peer memory needs the HIP runtime library")
+    lib.hipIpcGetMemHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(_IpcHandle), ctypes.c_void_p]
+    lib.hipIpcOpenMemHandle.argtypes = [
+        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p),
+        _IpcHandle,
+        ctypes.c_uint,
+    ]
+    lib.hipIpcCloseMemHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
+    lib.hipPointerGetAttribute.argtypes = [
+        ctypes.c_void_p,
+        ctypes.c_int,
+        ctypes.c_void_p,
+    ]
+    lib.hipGetErrorString.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
+    _hip = lib
+    return lib
+
+
+def _check(error: int, what: str) -> None:
+    if error:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{what} failed: {_lib().hipGetErrorString(error).decode()}")
+
+
+def _export(pointer: int) -> tuple[bytes, int]:
+    base = ctypes.c_void_p()
+    _check(
+        _lib().hipPointerGetAttribute(
+            ctypes.byref(base), _RANGE_START_ADDR, ctypes.c_void_p(pointer)
+        ),
+        "hipPointerGetAttribute",
+    )
+    handle = _IpcHandle()
+    _check(_lib().hipIpcGetMemHandle(ctypes.byref(handle), base), "hipIpcGetMemHandle")
+    return bytes(handle.reserved), pointer - (base.value or 0)
+
+
+def _open(handle: bytes) -> int:
+    h = _IpcHandle()
+    ctypes.memmove(ctypes.byref(h), handle, _IPC_HANDLE_BYTES)
+    mapped = ctypes.c_void_p()
+    _check(
+        _lib().hipIpcOpenMemHandle(ctypes.byref(mapped), h, _LAZY_ENABLE_PEER_ACCESS),
+        "hipIpcOpenMemHandle",
+    )
+    return mapped.value or 0
+
+
+class PeerBuffers:
+    """``nbytes`` of zeroed device memory on every TP rank; ``addresses[r]`` is
+    rank r's buffer as mapped in this process. Collective: every rank builds it
+    at the same point, and every rank must call ``close`` in the same order."""
+
+    def __init__(self, nbytes: int, rank: int, npes: int, group) -> None:
+        import torch.distributed as dist
+
+        self.rank, self.npes, self.group = rank, npes, group
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+        self.storage = torch.zeros(nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        local = self.storage.data_ptr()
+        self._remote: list[int] = []
+        if npes == 1:
+            pointers = [local]
+        else:
+            mine: tuple | str
+            try:
+                mine = _export(local)
+            except RuntimeError as err:
+                mine = str(err)
+            exported: list = [None] * npes
+            dist.all_gather_object(exported, mine, group=group)
+            failed = [
+                f"rank {r}: {e}" for r, e in enumerate(exported) if isinstance(e, str)
+            ]
+            if failed:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "MonoKernel peer export failed: " + "; ".join(failed)
+                )
+            pointers, error = [], None
+            for r, (handle, offset) in enumerate(exported):
+                if r == rank:
+                    pointers.append(local)
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    base = _open(handle)
+                except RuntimeError as e:
+                    error = str(e)
+                    break
+                self._remote.append(base)
+                pointers.append(base + offset)
+            status: list = [None] * npes
+            dist.all_gather_object(status, error, group=group)
+            failed = [f"rank {r}: {e}" for r, e in enumerate(status) if e]
+            if failed:
+                self._close_remote()
+                raise RuntimeError("MonoKernel peer open failed: " + "; ".join(failed))
+            dist.barrier(group=group)
+        self.addresses = torch.tensor(pointers, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def _close_remote(self) -> None:
+        for base in self._remote:
+            _lib().hipIpcCloseMemHandle(ctypes.c_void_p(base))
+        self._remote.clear()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(self.storage.device)
+        if self.npes > 1:
+            import torch.distributed as dist
+
+            dist.barrier(group=self.group)
+        self._close_remote()

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The GLM-5.3-Flash specialized decode (layer mode): one routing decision per step,
+then a whole-layer MonoKernel launch for every MoE decoder layer 3..43 inside the
+stock layer loop.
+
+Built by the model state once the weights are loaded (``Glm5NextModelState``): reads
+vLLM's loaded weights in place (``weights``) and builds every width's launches
+before memory profiling and graph capture. ``bind_caches`` binds them to every KV
+cache vLLM allocates (the CUDA-graph memory-profiling cache, then the real one).
+Each step ``plan`` returns a ``Step`` or None; ``Step.layer(i)`` is the launch
+replacing decoder layer i (None for vLLM's layers). Weight reloads are not
+supported."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import operator
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import partial
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+from . import layers
+from .context import DecodeContext, DecodeStep
+from .failstop import OUTPUT_RANK, HealthWatch, counters
+from .guards import model_refusals
+from .routing import step_reason
+from .spec import STAGES, DecodeConfig, kernel_layers
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from collections.abc import Callable
+
+    from torch import nn
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _capturing() -> bool:
+    return torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+
+
+def _resolve(module: nn.Module, path: str) -> torch.Tensor:
+    attrs, _, index = path.partition("[")
+    value = operator.attrgetter(attrs)(module)
+    if index:
+        value = value[int(index.rstrip("]"))]
+    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        value = value[0]
+    if not isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path} is not a tensor")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Step:
+    """A planned kernel step and its launch per kernel layer."""
+
+    step: DecodeStep
+    kernels: dict[int, Any]
+
+    def layer(self, idx: int) -> Callable[..., Any] | None:
+        """The launch replacing decoder layer idx (it takes and returns what
+        ``Glm5NextDecoderLayer`` does), or None for vLLM's layer."""
+        kernel = self.kernels.get(idx)
+        if kernel is None:
+            return None
+        return partial(_launch, kernel, self.step)
+
+
+def _launch(kernel: Any, step: DecodeStep, positions: torch.Tensor, *args: Any):
+    return kernel.launch(step, *args)
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode:
+    """The executor: packs the kernel layers' weights, builds every width's launches,
+    binds them to each KV cache and plans every step."""
+
+    def __init__(self, backbone: nn.Module, cfg: DecodeConfig) -> None:
+        from vllm.distributed import (
+            get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
+            get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+            get_tp_group,
+        )
+        from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import PPMissingLayer
+
+        reasons = model_refusals(backbone)
+        if reasons:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "--monokernel cannot run the GLM-5.3-Flash specialized decode on "
+                "this model: " + "; ".join(reasons) + "."
+            )
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        start = getattr(backbone, "start_layer", 0)
+        end = getattr(backbone, "end_layer", len(backbone.layers))
+        self.layers: dict[int, nn.Module] = {
+            i: backbone.layers[i]
+            for i in kernel_layers(backbone.config)
+            if start <= i < end and not isinstance(backbone.layers[i], PPMissingLayer)
+        }
+        vllm_config = backbone.vllm_config
+        self.ctx = DecodeContext(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            tp_size=get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size(),
+            tp_rank=get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+            cpu_group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+            device=torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+            if torch.cuda.is_available()
+            else torch.device("cpu"),
+        )
+        self.ctx.state["poll_timeout_us"] = cfg.poll_timeout_us
+        self.packed = layers.pack(backbone, self.ctx)
+        self.metadata_names = layers.metadata_names(self.layers)
+        self.kernels = {
+            width: {
+                idx: layers.build(self.ctx, self.packed, layer, idx, width)
+                for idx, layer in self.layers.items()
+            }
+            for width in cfg.widths
+        }
+        words, seen = [], set()
+        for per_width in self.kernels.values():
+            for kernel in per_width.values():
+                w = kernel.health()
+                if w.data_ptr() not in seen:
+                    seen.add(w.data_ptr())
+                    words.append(w)
+        flags = self.ctx.state.get("flags") if self.ctx.tp_rank == OUTPUT_RANK else None
+        self.watch = HealthWatch(
+            "GLM-5.3-Flash", words, STAGES, self.ctx.tp_rank, flags
+        )
+        self._cache_key: tuple | None = None
+        logger.info_once(
+            "GLM-5.3-Flash specialized decode: %d MonoKernel layers, widths %s, "
+            "step tokens %s; numerics: %s.",
+            len(self.layers),
+            "/".join(map(str, cfg.widths)),
+            "/".join(map(str, cfg.tokens)),
+            "; ".join(cfg.numerics),
+        )
+        mode = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+        if mode is None or mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
+            logger.warning("GLM-5.3-Flash MonoKernel running eagerly: debugging only.")
+
+    def caches(self) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        out = {}
+        for idx, layer in self.layers.items():
+            for name, (path, _, when) in layers.CACHES.items():
+                if when(layer):
+                    out[f"{idx}.{name}"] = _resolve(layer, path)
+        return out
+
+    def bind_caches(self) -> None:
+        """Check and bind the KV caches vLLM just bound (the CUDA-graph memory
+        profiling cache, then the real one); a no-op if none moved."""
+        caches = self.caches()
+        key = tuple((k, t.data_ptr(), t.numel()) for k, t in caches.items())
+        if key == self._cache_key:
+            return
+        if _capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "GLM-5.3-Flash MonoKernel caches moved inside CUDA graph capture"
+            )
+        reasons = []
+        for k, t in caches.items():
+            dtypes = layers.CACHES[k.split(".", 1)[1]][1]
+            if t.dtype not in dtypes:
+                reasons.append(f"{k}: dtype {t.dtype}")
+            if t.dim() and t.stride(-1) != 1:
+                reasons.append(f"{k}: last dim not contiguous")
+        reasons += layers.bind(self.ctx, caches)
+        if reasons:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "GLM-5.3-Flash MonoKernel cannot use these caches: "
+                + "; ".join(reasons)
+            )
+        self._cache_key = key
+
+    def plan(self, positions: torch.Tensor, intermediate_tensors: Any) -> Step | None:
+        """This step's plan, or None to run vLLM's layers: pipeline stage inputs and
+        steps ``routing.step_reason`` or the layers' eligibility decline. A kernel
+        step re-binds the caches if they moved (a no-op otherwise)."""
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None or not is_forward_context_available():
+            return None
+        fc = get_forward_context()
+        tokens = positions.shape[-1]
+        reason = step_reason(fc, tokens, self.cfg, self.metadata_names)
+        step = None
+        if reason is None:
+            width = self.cfg.width_for(tokens)
+            # step_reason declined micro-batched (list) metadata
+            assert width is not None and isinstance(fc.attn_metadata, dict)
+            step = DecodeStep(tokens, width, positions, fc.attn_metadata)
+            reason = layers.eligible(self.ctx, step)
+        if reason is not None:
+            key = f"vllm_path:{reason}"
+            if not counters[key]:
+                logger.debug("GLM-5.3-Flash MonoKernel: vLLM path for %s", reason)
+            counters[key] += 1
+            return None
+        assert step is not None
+        self.bind_caches()
+        counters["mono_steps"] += 1
+        return Step(step, self.kernels[step.width])
+
+    def health(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.watch.health()
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        """Once per executed step, from compute_logits (eager on every rank, also
+        under graph replay). Fail-stop on expired kernel waits."""
+        self.watch.after_step()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Health check of the kernels' error words and the fail-stop that follows."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections
+import faulthandler
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.glm5next.amd.specialized_decode.mono import abi
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+OUTPUT_RANK = 0
+EXIT_GRACE_S = 30.0
+WORKER_EXIT_CODE = 70
+
+counters: collections.Counter[str] = collections.Counter()
+
+
+def fail_stop(msg: str, rank: int) -> None:
+    """Ranks other than the output rank exit their worker; the output rank raises
+    and exits after a grace period with a stack dump, so no worker keeps spinning
+    in a collective."""
+    counters["incidents"] += 1
+    if rank != OUTPUT_RANK:
+        logger.critical("%s; terminating this worker", msg)
+        os._exit(WORKER_EXIT_CODE)
+    logger.error("%s; this worker exits in %.0f s", msg, EXIT_GRACE_S)
+    faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(EXIT_GRACE_S, exit=True)
+    raise RuntimeError(msg)
+
+
+class HealthWatch:
+    """Error words of every kernel runtime on this rank (one int32 per stage) and,
+    on the output rank, every rank's expiry flag.
+
+    ``health()`` is what the runner reads after a step. ``after_step()`` checks the
+    previous step's copy without blocking the stream. Words are sticky; only
+    ``VLLM_MONO_UNSAFE_WARN=1`` clears them, after logging."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        words: list[torch.Tensor],
+        stages: tuple[str, ...],
+        rank: int,
+        flags: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        for w in words:
+            assert w.dtype == torch.int32 and w.numel() == len(stages), w.shape
+        self._name, self._stages, self._rank = name, stages, rank
+        self._dev = list(words) + ([flags] if flags is not None else [])
+        self._has_flags = flags is not None
+        pin = torch.cuda.is_available()
+        self._host = [
+            torch.zeros(t.shape, dtype=t.dtype, pin_memory=pin) for t in self._dev
+        ]
+        self._event: torch.cuda.Event | None = None
+        self._unsafe_warn = abi.unsafe_warn()
+
+    def health(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.cat([t.to(torch.int32).flatten() for t in self._dev])
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        if self._event is not None and self._event.query():
+            self.check([h.tolist() for h in self._host])
+        for h, d in zip(self._host, self._dev):
+            h.copy_(d, non_blocking=True)
+        if self._event is None:
+            self._event = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self._event.record()
+
+    def check(self, values: list[list[int]]) -> None:
+        words = values[:-1] if self._has_flags else values
+        flags = values[-1] if self._has_flags else []
+        bad = sorted({self._stages[i] for w in words for i, v in enumerate(w) if v})
+        peers = [r for r, v in enumerate(flags) if v]
+        if not bad and not peers:
+            return
+        msg = (
+            f"{self._name} MonoKernel rank {self._rank}: expired waits"
+            f"{' in ' + ', '.join(bad) if bad else ''}"
+            f"{'; ranks flagging an expiry: ' + str(peers) if peers else ''}"
+            "; tokens of the affected steps are wrong"
+        )
+        if not self._unsafe_warn:
+            fail_stop(msg, self._rank)
+        counters["incidents"] += 1
+        logger.error("%s [%s=1: continuing]", msg, abi.UNSAFE_WARN_ENV)
+        for d in self._dev:
+            d.zero_()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Refusals that need the loaded model or the device, every reason at once."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .spec import GRID, is_dsa, is_kda, kernel_layers
+from .weights import experts_backend_reason
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from torch import nn
+
+
+def model_refusals(backbone: nn.Module) -> list[str]:
+    """Why the loaded layers or this GPU cannot run the kernels (empty: they can)."""
+    reasons = []
+    for idx in kernel_layers(backbone.config):
+        layer = backbone.layers[idx]
+        why = experts_backend_reason(layer)
+        if why is not None:
+            reasons.append(f"layer {idx}: {why}")
+        if not getattr(layer, "mhc", False) or getattr(layer, "is_mtp_layer", False):
+            reasons.append(f"layer {idx}: needs an mHC decoder layer")
+        if getattr(layer, "is_sequence_parallel", False):
+            reasons.append(f"layer {idx}: sequence-parallel layer")
+        if not hasattr(layer.self_attn, "o_proj"):
+            reasons.append(f"layer {idx}: needs the attention's o_proj")
+        if is_kda(layer) and getattr(layer.self_attn, "num_spec", None):
+            reasons.append(f"layer {idx}: KDA with speculative decoding")
+        if is_dsa(layer) and getattr(layer.self_attn, "indexer", None) is None:
+            reasons.append(f"layer {idx}: sparse attention without its indexer")
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return reasons + ["needs ROCm"]
+    try:
+        import flydsl  # noqa: F401
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops  # noqa: F401
+    except ImportError as err:
+        reasons.append(f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({err})")
+    cus = current_platform.num_compute_units(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    if cus < GRID:
+        # every CTA of a launch must stay resident (a partitioned GPU has fewer)
+        reasons.append(f"needs {GRID} compute units, the GPU has {cus}")
+    return reasons
